asset_binding.task_id_basis: installed benchmark source order; base order index 0 is identity; PRO swap uses shared base names in source order
asset_binding.seed_mapping: init_index=seed % init_count; specific_reset_id=sum(prior task init counts)+init_index; fixed seed does not prove intermediate snapshot/restore
asset_binding.init_evidence: ZIP + pickletools opcode inspection only; no torch import, unpickle, simulation or GPU

hard_constraints.safety: No confirmed execution safety or governance breach; native finite action, configured step/timeout and tool permissions remain enforced; missing evidence=null.
hard_constraints.compatibility: Model, processor, normalization, observations/actions, native chunk protocol and bundle artifacts are compatible with recorded backend contract; missing checks=null.
hard_constraints.critical_old_preserved: old_milk and old_drawer each established on public seeds0/1; candidate succeeds at least once on each and never below matched current or fixed anchor success counts.
hard_constraints.reference_coverage: All eight public seeds0/1 task slots per side require independent native/terminal results, necessary L0, technical validity, complete cost and critical_progress evidence; missing/unknown/invalid implies inconclusive.
hard_constraints.resource_limits: No per-attempt or aggregate authorized resource cap exceeded; missing full-cost ledger=null.
hard_constraints.critical_progress: No confirmed duplicate completion submission, action using invalidated historical coordinates, or advance that requires an unverified holding/goal fact. Only preconditions actually consumed by executed skills are required; reference evidence for those transitions must be available or this check=null. Optional released/settled labels are not new native success conditions.

outcomes.denominator: All preassigned task-seed slots, including refused, unstarted due to batch stop, timeout, unknown and invalid. One slot remains one denominator entry; no replacement or post-outcome exclusion.
outcomes.success: Independent native benchmark success=true, linked episode/bundle/protocol; Planner finish, tool heuristic or terminated alone cannot establish success.
outcomes.failure: Independent native success=false after authorized attempt ends or budget is exhausted with complete terminal evidence.
outcomes.unknown: Independent result absent/conflicting, or stopped slot not run; never infer success from no alarm.
outcomes.invalid: Technical setup/protocol/data failure flag, independent of outcome; score contribution zero and counts in all-slot denominator.
outcomes.score_contribution: 1 only for success AND valid; all other slots 0.
outcomes.gate_missing_fraction: union(outcome=unknown, validity=invalid, missing slot) / all assigned slots; must equal zero for accept in each of candidate/current/anchor.
outcomes.native_definition: Release/settle labels are process evidence only; do not silently strengthen or replace the native benchmark goal.

state_evaluation.sampling: At initial observation, after each state-changing tool, each handoff/recovery, and terminal observation; only task-applicable states are expected and the set is fixed before the attempt.
state_evaluation.zero_denominator: null, never 0 or 1; required evidence missing leads inconclusive
state_evaluation.privileged_state: Evaluator-only reference does not enter runtime policy. Unknown ground truth remains missing reference; system statements do not supply the reference.

recovery.mid_attempt_reset: Terminates original attempt, record linked new attempt if separately authorized. No reset retry authorized by this pilot. Never upgrade original slot to success from retry.
recovery.causal_claim: Triggered recovery samples alone do not identify recovery benefit. A future causal comparison needs preallocated independent controls under same budget.

purpose: Finite public engineering comparison for useful tabletop task improvement; not an H3 unseen-problem exam.

release.feedback: public, available for research after full baseline; fixed before candidates

budget.storage_semantics: Each Runtime cap includes its output and scratch together; no duplicate scratch reserve. Offline pool includes all already consumed work, tests, preparation, wait and closure.
budget.tokens: observed_only; cached is an input subset; no currency estimate

initial_requirements.meaning: base succeeds on both public states; each old task succeeds at least once; controlled outcomes fully known; no self-relative gain requirement.

selection: chronologically_first_technically_valid_attempt; valid failure is final; retain every attempt and all costs
knowledge_boundary: Seeds0/1 and historical memories are public/previously observed; development seed2 is disjoint by initial index. No claim that these tasks or states are unseen.
intervention_policy: Candidate not generated in this preparation. Freeze actual candidate diff and shared non-intervention artifacts before development; changed execution/input semantics require new matched baseline. Preserve active bundle identity.

metric_definition.denominator: all 8 fixed public task/seed slots per side; missing/unknown/invalid remain denominator entries
metric_definition.success_old: macro average of old_milk and old_drawer, each over seeds0/1
metric_definition.claim: finite engineering coverage, not statistical efficacy or H3

version_registration: Pre-execution control/evaluation registration; zero new protocol10 Runtime or candidate results observed.

research_selection.rule: First single well-formed permitted candidate from the one response; stop or invalid response ends candidate branch; never select on comparison outcomes.

development_selection.rule: Research must register at most two distinct development task/seed slots and their order with the candidate before any development observation; never replace a valid failure.
development_selection.unknown_or_invalid: retain every attempt/cost; only preauthorized closed technical recovery; no synthetic substitute
